The Basics of Logic Fundvex

Like most platforms in this category, Logic Fundvex presents signal-assisted trading through a web dashboard. You set preferences and the system flags or places trades for you. The mechanics are ordinary, so the real question is who is behind them.

What Our Checks Found

Our checks did not turn up a confirmed operator, regulator, or operating history for Logic Fundvex. The $250 minimum deposit matches what most platforms in this category ask, so it says little about whether the service is trustworthy.

Checks to Make First

  • Start with the $250 minimum, and nothing more.
  • Use any demo mode before going live.
  • Check the registration or licence number against the actual regulator.
  • Confirm who owns and runs the platform.

Risk Factors

Without a confirmed regulator, you have limited protection if a withdrawal is refused or an account is frozen. Even a legitimate signal platform cannot remove ordinary market losses.

Where We Land on Logic Fundvex
